messages:
Maria: Heads-up — noticed a ~3-7% invoice_preview delta for a handful of tenants after the route-priority canary rolled yesterday. Looks like a subset of enriched events are missing `charge_origin` so cost attribution falls back to `unknown` and shows as bumped in preview.
Lee: ugh. which canary? route-priority-service v2?
Maria: yes, the v2 rollout (50% traffic, region-us). The spike lines up with 02:10–03:00 UTC.
OncallBot: Alert: invoice_preview_delta > 5% for workspace: acme-inc (region: us) at 2024-06-14T02:37:12Z :warning:
Raj: quick query to confirm — run: `select count(*) from metering.events where charge_origin is null and created_at >= '2024-06-14T02:00:00Z'`
Sasha: ran that, we have ~12.4k nulls, ~0.9% of daily events but concentrated across 6 tenants.
Tim: are those events that hit the enrichment sidecar or the central enricher? could be a header rename during v2.
Maria: trace shows route-priority-service v2 switched header `x-route-origin` -> `x-charge-origin` but the enricher was reading old header for a short window.
Lee: oh nice catch. so two fixes: 1) make enricher accept both headers (backcompat), 2) patch canary to include the old header temporarily.
Raj: agree. second question: do we need a retroactive exclusion for invoice_preview (i.e., re-run preview backfill) or will defaulting be fine?
Sasha: customers saw the bump in preview only, actual billed tokens in ledger are fine — this is attribution-only.
Tim: still want to avoid customer alarm. propose: hotfix enricher to fallback to `x-charge-origin || x-route-origin`, deploy to enricher in us, then re-run preview job for the affected window for the 6 tenants.
Maria: timeline?
Lee: I can push the fallback in 20m. patch is one-liner in `enricher/src/http.ts`. Example: `const origin = req.headers['x-charge-origin'] || req.headers['x-route-origin'] || 'unknown'`
Raj: I'll prep the preview replayer job: `./tools/replay_preview --tenant acme-inc --start 2024-06-14T02:00 --end 2024-06-14T04:00` — should be safe but quota-costly, will run one tenant at a time.
Sasha: also adding a metric alert to the console: `metering.attr_null_rate` > 0.5% for 5m should fire to eng-platform oncall.
Tim: +1 on alert. we need a dashboard card to show attr-null by route-version so we can spot regressions during rollouts.
Maria: can we avoid rollback? customers have small preview noise, if we fix enricher fast and replay previews it should calm down.
Lee: deploying patch to enricher now -> will canary to 10% and monitor.
OncallBot: Deploy started: enricher v1.14.3 -> canary 10% at 2024-06-14T03:05:00Z
Sasha: FYI console team — please add an annotation for the route-priority v2 rollout at 2024-06-14 02:00 so support sees it with invoice previews.
Maria: thanks. postmortem note: add schema compatibility tests for header renames and a contract test between route-resolver and enricher.
Tim: I'll open a tiny RFC for header versioning + suggest we centralize charge attribution header name.
Raj: replay started for acme-inc (2024-06-14 02:00-04:00). ETA ~ 12m. I will post results here.
Maria: great. please also surface the tenant-level preview delta in the console so CS can proactively message affected customers.
Raj: replay finished — preview delta for acme-inc corrected from +6.2% -> +0.1% after replay + enricher fallback.
Lee: patch promoted to 100% at 2024-06-14T03:20:00Z.
Sasha: alert rule added and dashboard card queued in #eng-platform-dashboards.
Maria: closing loop. follow-ups: (1) contract tests (2) preview-run cost estimate docs (3) add automated small-window replays when attr_null spikes.
Tim: thanks all. :thumbsup:
notes: Canary header rename caused attribute-null attribution noise in invoice previews. Hotfix + replay corrected previews for affected tenants. Action items: contract tests, dashboard card, replay automation.
